# Whole *A. distichus* species group

## Download genome sequences for outgroup *Ctenonotus* species
```{bash, eval = FALSE}
#!/usr/bin/env bash
#SBATCH --job-name=SRAdownload
#SBATCH --mail-type=FAIL,END
#SBATCH --mail-user=tcm0036@auburn.edu
#SBATCH --time=6:00:00
#SBATCH --mem 32G
#SBATCH --partition jro0014_amd
#SBATCH --output=SRAtoolkit_%j.out
#SBATCH --error=SRAtoolkit_%j.err

### load conda environment with SRA-toolkit
source ~/mambaforge/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate genomics_env

### move to directory with WGS data
OUT=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/outgroup

if [ ! -d "$OUT" ]; then

        echo "$OUT does not exist; making directory to download files"
        mkdir -p $OUT

fi

cd $OUT

runs=(SRR4238387 SRR24030173)

for run in "${runs[@]}"; do
    echo "Processing $run..."

    # Step 1: Download using prefetch and fasterq-dump
    prefetch $run  # Downloads the SRA file to a directory named by the run ID
    fasterq-dump $run  # Converts the SRA file to paired-end fastq files

    # Step 2: Compress the fastq files using bgzip
    if [[ -f ${run}_1.fastq ]]; then
        bgzip ${run}_1.fastq
        rm ${run}_1.fastq  # Remove uncompressed file after compression
    fi

    if [[ -f ${run}_2.fastq ]]; then
        bgzip ${run}_2.fastq
        rm ${run}_2.fastq  # Remove uncompressed file after compression
    fi

    # Step 3: Delete the prefetch directory (the SRA download directory)
     if [[ -d $run ]]; then
        rm -rf $run  # Removes the directory created by prefetch
    fi
  
    echo "Finished processing $run."
done
```

## Align outgroup sequences to *A. distichus* v1 reference with `BWA MEM`
```{bash, eval = FALSE}
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=Anodist_aln
#SBATCH --array=1-2
#SBATCH --mem=65G
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=16
#SBATCH --time=1-12:00:00
#SBATCH --partition=nova_28

# Load modules
module load bwa/0.7.17
module load samtools/1.15

## Define vars
SAMPLES=( SRR24030173 SRR4238387 )
SAMPLE=${SAMPLES[$((SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID - 1))]}
echo $SAMPLE

READ_DIR=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/outgroup
REF=/home/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/genome/Anolis_distichus/AnoDis1.0.fasta.gz
FQ1=$(find ${READ_DIR} -type f -name "${SAMPLE}*1.f*q.gz" -not -name "*.rem.*")
FQ2=$(find ${READ_DIR} -type f -name "${SAMPLE}*2.f*q.gz" -not -name "*.rem.*")
SAM=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/alignments/AnoDist/sam/${SAMPLE}.aligned.sam
BAM=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/alignments/AnoDist/bam/outgroup/${SAMPLE}.aligned.bam
SORTED=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/alignments/AnoDist/bam/outgroup/${SAMPLE}.aligned.sorted.bam

echo $FQ1
echo $FQ2

## Align reads
bwa mem -t 8 $REF $FQ1 $FQ2 |\
samtools view -b > $BAM

## Sort & index
samtools sort -o $SORTED $BAM
samtools index $SORTED
```

## Use `Stacks` to call variants and generate a VCF for the outgroup species
```{bash, eval = FALSE}
#!/usr/bin/env bash
#SBATCH --job-name=brev-stacks
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=1
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=10
#SBATCH --partition=jro0014_amd
#SBATCH --mem=82gb
#SBATCH --time=48:00:00
#SBATCH --mail-user=tcm0036@auburn.edu
#SBATCH --mail-type=FAIL,END
#SBATCH --error=err.pops_%j
#SBATCH --output=out.pops_%j

# module load stacks/2.61
source ~/mambaforge/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate genomics_env

BAM_DIR=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/alignments/AnoDist/bam/
POPMAP=/home/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-ms/brevirostris-project-master-popmap.tsv
CAT_DIR=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/stacks/gstacks/with-outgroup
OUT_DIR=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/stacks/populations/with-outgroup

## Make popmap with individual names as population IDs, A. pulchellus as outgroup
awk -F"\t" -v OFS="\t" '{print $2, $3}' $POPMAP | grep -v "cristatellus" > tmp.tsv

# Run `gstacks` to assemble a catalog of RAD loci
## -I specifies input file directory, in this case sorted .BAM files from BWA MEM and samtools
## -M specifies the population map
## -O specifies the output directory
gstacks -I $BAM_DIR -M tmp.tsv -t 10 -O $CAT_DIR

## Run populations to generate an unfiltered VCF for SNP-specific analyses
## When running with only distichoids, haplotypes were exported and no other filtering
## arguments were provided, but given that the outgroups are whole genome sequences,
## I specify `--no-hap-exports` to prevent export of haplotypes, and these filters:
## -p 2: a locus must be present in at least 2 populations to be retained
## -r 0.2: a locus must be present in at least 20% of individuals in a population to be processed
populations -P $CAT_DIR -M tmp.tsv --vcf --no-hap-exports -p 2 -r 0.2 -t 4 -O $OUT_DIR

echo "Compressing output files..."
bgzip -f ${OUT_DIR}/populations.snps.vcf
```

This gives us ~2.6 million SNPs on 168K ddRAD loci.

## Filter VCF for `DSuite`
```{bash, eval = FALSE}
#! /usr/bin/env bash
#SBATCH --mail-type=FAIL,END
#SBATCH --mail-user=tcm0036@auburn.edu
#SBATCH --partition=jro0014_amd
#SBATCH --mem=32G
#SBATCH --error=snpfilt_%j.err
#SBATCH --output=snpfilt_%j.out
#SBATCH --time=24:00:00
#SBATCH --job-name=SNPFilter

## Load conda env with bcftools
source ~/mambaforge/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate genomics_env

VCF=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/stacks/populations/with-outgroup/populations.snps.vcf.gz
OUT_VCF=/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/geneflow/dsuite/pulchellus-outgroup/filtered_outgroup_miss90.vcf.gz

awk '{print $2}' ~/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-ms/sampling-master-detailed.tsv | grep -v 'specimen_path' > keepers.txt
echo "SRR24030173.aligned.sorted" >> keepers.txt

bcftools view -S keepers.txt $VCF | \
      bcftools filter -i 'FORMAT/DP > 5' | \
      bcftools filter -e 'F_MISSING > 0.9' | \
      bcftools view -m2 -M2 -v snps |\
      bcftools sort -O z -o $OUT_VCF
bcftools index $OUT_VCF
```

So I don't have to go back and re-run phylogeny inference with the *A. pulchellus* outgroup added, I will change the Newick tree file from `IQ-TREE` to designate an outgroup:
```
(aurifer:0.0980837374,((((((((biminiensis:0.0233515716,distichoides:0.0105391848)100/100:0.1262239141,(dapsilis:0.0903865529,distichus:0.0557311505)79.7/98:0.0000101037)100/100:0.0408845412,ocior:0.1027957373)100/100:0.7191316355,((((((brevirostris:0.3819707077,(caudalis:0.2098529618,marron:0.2726176600)100/100:0.3747486655)100/100:0.1445970914,websteri:0.6347060224)100/100:0.3612517893,ravitergum:0.5050476492)100/100:0.1000053540,west_ignigularis:0.2162089580)100/100:0.0343450597,(east_ignigularis:0.1103674671,(properus:0.0451861515,sejunctus:0.3951888484)100/100:0.1650717678)100/100:0.1149243153)100/100:0.0666388807,dom2:0.2363244078)100/100:0.1315007243)100/100:0.2489288624,(dom4:0.1818112068,dom1:0.2291402602)100/100:0.0784511888)100/100:0.1411129425,favillarum:0.3881855201)100/100:0.0858318629,dom3:0.1759631309)100/100:0.1521620622,vinosus:0.1094541089)100/100:0.0262677290,suppar:0.1487910958);
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(ape)
library(phytools)

### Read in unrooted tree from IQ-TREE
tree = read.tree("/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/phylo/pomo/PoMo_full_miss90LD_loci.treefile")

### Root the tree by declaring the brevirostris clade as the outgroup
tree2 = root(tree, resolve.root=T, outgroup = c("brevirostris", "caudalis", "marron", "websteri"))

### now, add a tip for the outgroup species, A. pulchellus, labelled "Outgroup"
tree3 <- bind.tip(tree2, tip.label = "Outgroup", where = length(tree2$tip.label) + 1, position = 0.1)
### remove support values since Dsuite won't use them
tree3$node.label <- NULL

write.tree(tree3, file = "PoMo_full_miss90LD_loci.rooted.nwk")
```

The *A. pulchellus* outgroup is now designated as "Outgroup" in the Newick file to match what Dsuite expects in the SETS file.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

fbranch <- read_table("/Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/snp-analyses/Dsuite/pulchellus-outgroup/fbranch_matrix.txt", na = "nan")
### Identify numeric taxon columns (exclude known non-taxon columns)
non_taxon_cols <- c("branch", "branch_descendants", "Outgroup")
taxon_cols <- setdiff(names(fbranch), non_taxon_cols)

long_df <- fbranch %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(taxon_cols), names_to = "taxon", values_to = "fval") %>%
    filter(!is.na(fval) & fval != 0)

zdf <- read_table("/Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/snp-analyses/Dsuite/pulchellus-outgroup/SETS_tree.txt", col_names = TRUE)
# Match and assign max |Z-score| where P3 == taxon
long_df$zscore <- sapply(long_df$taxon, function(taxon) {
  matches <- as.numeric(zdf$`Z-score`[zdf$P3 == taxon])
  if (length(matches) > 0 && any(!is.na(matches))) {
    max(abs(matches), na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    NA
  }
})

### Compute 2-tailed p-values and FDR
long_df <- long_df %>%
    mutate(
      p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(zscore)),
      fdr = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr"),
      significant = fdr < 0.05
    )
long_df

### Show significant results
cat("Significant f-branch introgression tests (FDR < 0.05):\n")
print(subset(long_df, significant)[, c("branch", "taxon", "fval", "zscore", "fdr")])

# Save all results to file
write.table(long_df, "/Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/snp-analyses/Dsuite/pulchellus-outgroup/fbranch_with_significance.txt", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
```
